items.title: Peso hits new low, nears P63/$1

items.title: Blanket suspensions seen hurting workers, businesses in Philippines
items.description: REPEATED and often blanket suspensions of face-to-face classes and government work due to typhoons and heavy rains are causing economic losses beyond missed work and school days, with daily-wage earners, small businesses and students bearing much of the impact, analysts said.

items.title: Fuel prices seen rising further as Middle East conflict escalates
items.description: FUEL PRICES could rise further in the coming weeks as the intensifying conflict in the Middle East keeps global oil markets under pressure, analysts said, as Filipino motorists brace for another increase of more than P4 per liter this week.

items.title: 64% say district reps ‘doing a good job’ – OCTA
items.description: About six in every 10 Filipinos believe that their district representatives are doing a good job, indicating what the OCTA Research group described as a stark difference between views at the local and institutional levels.

items.title: 2 areas in BARMM placed under Comelec control
items.description: Two areas in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao were placed under the control of the Commission on Elections following reports of violent incidents and compromised ballots during the region’s first parliamentary elections.

items.title: BIR scraps VAT on system loss charge
items.description: The Bureau of Internal Revenue has formally removed the value-added tax on the allowable system loss charge in electricity bills, a move seen to lower the amount passed on to consumers.

items.title: Ex-justice: VP may be removed for hiding assets

items.title: Senate OKs 5-year barangay, SK term bill
